name: wikipedia_graph
description: An interactive web visualization and route-finding engine for the entire English Wikipedia link graph. This application visualizes ~6.9 million articles and ~100 million links as a cohesive layout, allowing users to find paths between arbitrary pages instantly in the browser.

name: FlipFocus
description: Super simple focus app, place phone face down to focus then set break timers with suggested legnth based on how long you focused for.
